summary: Complete testing of HUNTIQ BIONIC™ Zone Analysis system. Backend API /api/bionic-territory/analyze/advanced is fully functional, returning behavior zones from WMS Québec data. Frontend integration working correctly - selecting a waypoint triggers automatic backend analysis, zones display on map, hotspot is identified with score/distance/time, and toast notifications appear. All 10 features tested and passing.

issues: Console shows 'Encountered two children with the same key' warnings for micro-zones - duplicate key issue in BionicMicroZones component (non-blocking)

passed_tests: Page Mon Territoire BIONIC loads correctly
Mode Temps Réel toggle ON by default
Waypoint selector dropdown functional (2 waypoints: test, L'Etang Ross)
Selecting waypoint triggers backend API call (/api/bionic-territory/analyze/advanced)
Backend returns behavior zones with WMS data (source: wms_real)
Behavior zones display on map after analysis
Hotspot optimal identified and displayed with score (93-98%)
Toast notification shows score and distance
Zone area change (2, 4, 10 km²) re-triggers analysis
Mode Temps Réel toggle can be toggled OFF/ON
COMPORTEMENTS GIBIER legend visible on map
Result panel displays: score, comportement dominant, distance, zones analysées, heure optimale, source données
critical_code_review_comments: BionicMicroZones component has duplicate key warnings - should add unique identifier to zone keys to prevent React warnings
WMS data source shows 'wms_real' but actual WMS servers may return simulated data as fallback - this is expected behavior per design
seed_data_creation: None required - 2 waypoints available (test, L'Etang Ross)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Zone analysis system is fully functional. Backend API returns behavior zones from WMS Québec data with fallback to simulation. Frontend correctly calls API when waypoint is selected in real-time mode. All UI components working: ZoneAnalysisControlPanel, Mode Temps Réel toggle, waypoint selector, zone area buttons, result panel with hotspot details. Minor issue: duplicate key warnings in console for micro-zones (non-blocking).
mocked_api_note: WMS Québec servers may return simulated data as fallback when real WMS servers are unavailable - this is expected behavior. The data_source field indicates 'wms_real' or 'simulated'.
